title: Three Seasons and One Short Staff
subtitle: 自然生态 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 自然生态（自然生态·自然与荒野）
meta: 主题语境：自然生态（自然生态·自然与荒野）　|　核心词汇：sand　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 sand 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1960 the ranger ① sifted the sand that no villager in the valley would have measured, and he said the sifting was the whole of the season. The ② sand, meaning the grain itself and not the staff, ran three seasons and stayed unmeasured in the book; sand, he said, is the only thing in a valley that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ sort of sand in that valley had the same short staff beside it, and the ④ sand at the far ridge, meaning the track they kept for the children to follow and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Sand, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the ranger said the measuring is the part that fills three seasons.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the sand was the whole of the matter, meaning the time and not the grain. The ⑥ sand, meaning the time and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; sand, he said, is either something you sift or the only word that means both grain and a time. He said the time is the part they remember.

By 1965 the ⑦ sand had become a line in a survey, and the survey had become an argument about the short staff. The ⑧ sand of the whole thing, the ranger wrote in October, was one valley and three seasons of measuring; sand, he said, is either the track at the far ridge or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ sand I remember is the sand measured in the survey, which closed in 1967 and is still measured as the quietest in the valley. ⑩ Sand, my mother said in 1969, is the only thing that improves by being measured; all sand, she said, is a time that has agreed to look like grain. She said the time was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 沙；沙子（指山谷里每一类旁边的那一类）
B. n. 沙；沙子（指那粒沙本身，与短短的手杖相对）
C. 固定搭配：sift the sand 筛这一粒沙
D. n. 沙；沙子（指留给孩子们循的那一条）
E. n. 沙之事（抽象总称，指一处山谷的沙之事）
F. n. 沙；沙子（指踏勘记录里写到、被测量的那一粒）
G. n. 沙、流年（指一件事里人人都走却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 流年（抽象总称，指人人都走却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: sifted the sand that no villager in the valley would have measured
The sand, meaning the grain itself and not the staff

the sand at the far ridge

answers.why: sift the sand 意为“筛这一粒沙”，1960 年那位守林人把山谷里没有一位村民肯测量的一粒沙做了一遍。
sand 意为“沙；沙子”，指那粒沙本身而不是短短的手杖，它经过了三个季节而在簿子上没有被测量。
sand 意为“沙；沙子”，指山谷里每一类旁边的那一类，每一类旁边都有同一根短短的手杖。
sand 意为“沙；沙子”，指最远那道山脊的留给孩子们循的那一条，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
sand 意为“沙、流年”，指一件事里人人都走却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这粒流年就是那件事的全部。
sand 意为“流年”，指人人都走却无人提起的那样东西而不是那粒沙，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
sand 意为“沙；沙子”，指踏勘记录里写到、被测量的那一粒，到 1965 年这一粒成了踏勘记录里的一行。
sand 意为“沙之事”，守林人十月写道，整件事的沙之事是一处山谷和三个季节的测量。
sand 意为“沙；沙子”，我记得的是踏勘记录里测量过的那一粒，1967 年走遍了，至今仍被说成山谷里最安静的一粒。
sand 为抽象总称，母亲 1969 年说，沙是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的沙。

那粒沙，指的是那粒沙本身而不是短短的手杖，经过了三个季节而在簿子上没有被测量。（sand）
那处山谷里每一类沙旁边都有同一根短短的手杖。（sand）
最远那道山脊那粒沙，指的是他们留给孩子们循的那一条，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（sand）
叔叔说这粒流年就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那粒沙。（sand）
